body:
I'll start by reading the outline and manifests to understand the shared contract, then verify all source lines before writing.

Let me read the three manifests with KEY_FACTS sections and check the VERSION file for official URLs.

Now the wiki manifest and VERSION for official URLs.

I have the contract and manifests. Now let me verify the exact source lines I'll cite. First, check which files exist and gather key fact lines in batch.

Note: `library__pickle.rst`/`libraries__UsingPickle.html` are not in samples. I'll verify lines for chapters 14 and 15 now.

Now chapter 16 uv sources. Let me verify all cited lines.

Now chapter 21 testing sources.

One final pin for a few line numbers, then I'll write all four files.

All lines verified. Now writing the four files, starting with chapter 14.

Let me verify a few wiki line citations I used before finalizing chapter 14.

Two citation corrections needed (missing index file, off-by-one wiki line, profiling namespace cite). Applying fixes.

My edit used incorrect line numbers and mangled the file. Re-reading to repair it.

Now applying the repair with correct line numbers.

Chapter 14 repaired. Let me verify a few remaining security lines, then write chapter 15.

Now chapter 16 — supply chain with PREVIEW markers.

Chapter 16 is at the upper byte limit; I'll also simplify one config example to avoid inventing a table shape. Let me inspect those lines.

Now chapter 21 — testing for determinism.

All four files written. Let me run a structural and citation-existence self-check.

Four files written to `/home/one/projects/one/ai-guides/languages/python_guide/` and validated against the shared contract.

| File | Bytes | Citations | Tables | URLs | Fences / max lines |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `14-performance-runtime.md` | 7,375 | 37 | 3 | 8 | 1 / 8 |
| `15-security-core.md` | 7,749 | 35 | 3 | 8 | 2 / 6 |
| `16-security-supply-chain.md` | 8,185 | 42 | 2 | 8 | 2 / 3 |
| `21-testing-for-determinism.md` | 7,369 | 33 | 3 | 7 | 2 / 14 |

**Validation:** first lines exactly `# NN - Title`; `## Sources` is the last section in all four; every fence is balanced, tagged, and ≤25 lines; every `samples/<file>:LINE` citation points to an existing file and an in-range line (0 bad out of 147). Key claims were additionally checked by reading the actual source lines. No TODO/placeholder text and no coverage claims.

**Markers used:**
- `14`: `wiki, lower authority` ×8 (all `performance__PythonSpeed.html` claims, with the CPython 2.4 historical caveat), `derived` ×6 (checklist, JIT/free-threading policy, buffering advice).
- `15`: `not verified` ×3 (pickle — capture file absent; env/secret handling; deserialisation), `wiki, lower authority` ×2 (thin wiki security hub), `derived` ×10.
- `16`: `PREVIEW`/`preview` ×19 (`uv audit`, `uv tool audit`, on-sync OSV malware check, `tool-install-locks`), `not verified` ×1 (SBOM completeness/signatures/CVE-free claims), `derived` ×4. Also documented the non-obvious fact that `uv publish` does **not** generate PEP 740 attestations, only uploads them.
- `21`: `not verified` ×8 (pytest/Hypothesis specifics, tempfile, `unittest.mock`, doctest directives, coverage tools, clock/timezone injection), `wiki, lower authority` ×6 (framework survey + legacy warning), `derived` ×6.

One repair was made mid-flight: an initial edit landed on wrong line numbers in chapter 14; I re-read the file, restored the code fence/table structure, and re-verified it (the validation results above are from the repaired file).
